newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS MARKET SLIPS ACROSS THE BOARD.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS MARKET SLIPS ACROSS THE BOARD.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures slipped in nearly all traded periods on Thursday, with volumes spread fairly evenly across the forward curve.
The morning session focused on the prompt months, while the afternoon saw trade concentrated on the coming winter months.
Several of the months shed 0.1 pence a therm (p/th) or more.
December and January both shed 0.125 to close at 15.55 p/th and 14.20 p/th respectively.
The only climber on Friday was August 1998, which was untraded but settled 0.04 p/th higher.
From Friday, trading hours on the IPE gas contract will be extended from 1000 hrs to 1700 hrs London time with no midday closure.
In addition, balance of the month trading will be introduced on the screen-based Energy Trading System (ETS) and the minimum tick size will be increased from 0.005 to 0.01 p/th.
